facts.text: John participated in a rescue mission where a family was saved from a burning building.

evidence.quote: I got a surge of energy and purpose, and we were able to save a family from a burning building.

facts.text: John described the rescue mission as chaotic but ultimately successful due to teamwork.

evidence.quote: It was chaotic when we arrived, but we pulled together.

facts.text: John mentioned that the rescue mission was an adrenaline rush and that he relied on his team for support.

evidence.quote: It was an adrenaline rush, and I couldn't have done it without them.
We trust and rely on one another, and it's great to know that we have each other's backs.

facts.text: John expressed that the experience of saving the family made the mission worth it.

evidence.quote: Knowing we made a difference made it worth it.
